title: ChatGPT Needed Just 2 Months To Reach 100 Million
hook: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just 2 months.
closing: Record growth also left a huge free-user bill to fund.
question: Do you pay for ChatGPT?

segments.say: ChatGPT grew from 100 million users in 2023 to 900 million in 2026.
ChatGPT reached its crowd in 2 months versus Instagram's 30 and TikTok's 9.
ChatGPT has 850 million free users against 50 million paying subscribers.
